name: identity and mounts
command: id -u; uname -srm; cat /proc/cmdline; cat /proc/mounts; cat /proc/filesystems; readlink /proc/1/exe; cfgcmd get InternetGatewayDevice.DeviceInfo.SoftwareVersion

name: service settings and state
command: printf 'ssh_enable='; cfgcmd get InternetGatewayDevice.Services.ServiceSSH.Enable; printf '\nssh_port='; cfgcmd get InternetGatewayDevice.Services.ServiceSSH.Port; printf '\n'; ps | grep -E 'tdsmgr|sysmgr|srvcmgr|dropbear|telnetd|crond'; netstat -lnt | awk 'NR<3 || $4 ~ /:(22|23|2222)$/'

name: safe binary references
command: for f in /usr/sbin/sysmgr /usr/sbin/tdsmgr /usr/sbin/utils /usr/sbin/srvcmgr; do echo $f; strings $f | grep -E '^(/data(/[^ ]*)?|.*sys.init_after.sh.*|.*dropbearkey.*|.*rsa_host_key.*|.*ServiceSSH.*|mount -t jffs2.*|.*autorun.*|.*rc.local.*)$' | head -40; done

name: baseline and final checks
command: md5sum /etc/inittab /etc/rc.d/rcS /usr/syscfg/sys.init_after.sh /usr/sbin/sysmgr /usr/sbin/dropbear; test ! -e /tmp/dlink-phase6a && echo no-test-tree; test ! -e /etc/dropbear && echo no-global-key-directory; awk '$3=="jffs2" {print $2,$3,$4}' /proc/mounts; id -u
